subject: psychic blade attack
fact: Milo describes this kind of attack as a psychic blade attack. It leaves no trace. There is this one moment where the Kenku Whistler used the psychic blades to fake an attack by Milo on an enemy.
source_quote: Milo describes this kind of attack as a psychic blade attack. It leaves no trace. There is this one moment where the Kenku Whistler used the psychic blades to fake an attack by Milo on an enemy.

subject: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair
fact: The Ghohlbrorn’s Lair offers the kind of accommodations one could expect from a Duergar: unpleasant, cold, and austere.
source_quote: The Ghohlbrorn’s Lair, to Daz’s refined sensibilities, offers the kind of accommodations one could expect from a Duergar: unpleasant, cold, and austere.

subject: assassination attempt
fact: Two assassins, wearing face coverings and wielding glowing weapons, strike the other man.
source_quote: Two assassins, wearing face coverings and wielding glowing weapons, strike the other man.

subject: magic missiles
fact: When Daz utters the mystical words, motes of light appear above his hand, and three fingers point at one of the assassins. A silent rush of air accompanies the flight of the magic missiles, and when they strike, a burst of light and a crackling sound fills the area.
source_quote: When Daz utters the mystical words, motes of light appear above his hand, and three fingers point at one of the assassins. A silent rush of air accompanies the flight of the magic missiles, and when they strike, a burst of light and a crackling sound fills the area.

subject: scorching rays
fact: He speaks the words for scorching rays and feels the rush of intense heat as the fiery energy is manifested. He points with his index finger, uses his thumb to sight, squints, and lets the rays loose. They travel quickly, leaving a streak of heat haze.
source_quote: He speaks the words for scorching rays and feels the rush of intense heat as the fiery energy is manifested. He points with his index finger, uses his thumb to sight, squints, and lets the rays loose. They travel quickly, leaving a streak of heat haze.

subject: Shattered Spire
fact: Come by the Shattered Spire tomorrow, and I will reward you.
source_quote: Come by the Shattered Spire tomorrow, and I will reward you.

subject: scented candles
fact: He notices they have a pleasant smell and passes them to Thorin. The dwarf smiles, 'Scented candles!'
source_quote: He notices they have a pleasant smell and passes them to Thorin. The dwarf smiles, 'Scented candles!'

subject: The Keepers of the Flame
fact: The Keepers of the Flame are in the far southeastern corner of the cave, and the journey is uneventful.
source_quote: The Keepers of the Flame are in the far southeastern corner of the cave, and the journey is uneventful.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: The dragon’s cavern is filled with a hoard of gems and coins. Sitting on top of it is a plump, overweight red dragon.
source_quote: The dragon’s cavern is filled with a hoard of gems and coins. Sitting on top of it is a plump, overweight red dragon.

subject: dragon's breath
fact: The dragon roars, 'If I catch anyone spying, I will kill them.' And with that, he breathes fire in a circle around the cavern. When nobody dies or screams, the dragon laughs.
source_quote: The dragon roars, 'If I catch anyone spying, I will kill them.' And with that, he breathes fire in a circle around the cavern. When nobody dies or screams, the dragon laughs.

subject: gold badges
fact: Gartokkar hands out some gold badges. Thorin weighs it in his hands.
source_quote: Gartokkar hands out some gold badges. Thorin weighs it in his hands.

subject: holy symbol of Laduguer
fact: Let me give you this holy symbol of Laduguer and these gold pins featuring Themberchaud’s profile.
source_quote: Let me give you this holy symbol of Laduguer and these gold pins featuring Themberchaud’s profile.

subject: dragon egg theft
fact: We lost face when the Gray Ghosts stole the valuable red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement.
source_quote: We lost face when the Gray Ghosts stole the valuable red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: With them, you can travel within Gracklstugh, but there are limits.
source_quote: With them, you can travel within Gracklstugh, but there are limits.

subject: Droki
fact: We have identified an agent of the Grey Ghosts. His name is Droki.
source_quote: We have identified an agent of the Grey Ghosts. His name is Droki.

subject: factional deception
fact: Themberchaud thinks we work for him. What Themberchaud doesn’t realize is that he works for us.
source_quote: Themberchaud thinks we work for him. What Themberchaud doesn’t realize is that he works for us.

subject: agent recruitment
fact: Your first mission is to do whatever the Keepers of the Flame ask you to, but report to Themberchaud first.
source_quote: Your first mission is to do whatever the Keepers of the Flame ask you to, but report to Themberchaud first.

subject: Milo Goodbarrel’s memoirs
fact: According to Milo Goodbarrel’s memoirs, chess played a significant role in negotiating with the metallic dragons.
source_quote: According to Milo Goodbarrel’s memoirs, chess played a significant role in negotiating with the metallic dragons.

subject: double agent status
fact: We work for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: We work for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame.

subject: triple agent status
fact: We are double agents, or is it triple agents? We work for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: I suppose we are double agents, or is it triple agents? We work for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame.

subject: dragon’s age and replacement
fact: Eventually, the Dragon moves on because he wants to see more of the world.
source_quote: Eventually, the Dragon moves on because he wants to see more of the world.

subject: bloodstained gloves
fact: He finds some coins, a pair of bloodstained gloves, and a box of candles.
source_quote: He finds some coins, a pair of bloodstained gloves, and a box of candles.

subject: charcoal drawing
fact: He does find a charcoal drawing of the merchant on one of the bodies.
source_quote: He does find a charcoal drawing of the merchant on one of the bodies.

subject: Gartokkar’s chambers
fact: The Duergar priest sits down in his chamber and says, 'I am so delighted to see that you accepted Themberchaud’s offer to be an agent of ours.'
source_quote: The Duergar priest sits down in his chamber and says, 'I am so delighted to see that you accepted Themberchaud’s offer to be an agent of ours.'
